instruction: Create two new local folders named ARCHIVE and BACKUP in Thunderbird.

metadata.explanation: Variation 2: Changed folder names from COMPANY/UNIVERSITY to ARCHIVE/BACKUP. Task requires creating two local folders in Thunderbird. Evaluator checks for folder existence by verifying both .msf index files and folder directories via ls command output. Uses existing check_list metric with regex patterns to match folder names.

Correct getter logic: Postconfig executes 'ls -R' on correct Thunderbird local folders directory path
Appropriate metric: check_list function correctly processes file output and matches regex patterns line-by-line
Semantically correct expected values: Regex patterns correctly verify both .msf index files and folder directories, matching Thunderbird's folder structure
Practical feasibility: ls command will successfully capture folder state, no UI dependency issues
